dataRequest.emailRequired: Enter an email address so we can reply
dataRequest.confirmRequired: Please confirm you understand what can and cannot be deleted
dataRequest.doneBody: Your reference is {{ref}}. We'll reply to {{contact}} by {{dueBy}} at the latest.
dataRequest.keepRef: Keep the reference in case you need to follow up.
dataRequest.signIn: Please log in to request or delete your data — a request applies to the account you're signed in as.
dataRequest.ledeDelete: We will delete everything 3Speak stores about you in our own database.
dataRequest.ledeExport: We will send you everything 3Speak stores about you in our own database, as a JSON file.
dataRequest.cannotBody: 3Speak is built on the Hive blockchain. Your posts, comments, votes and reshares were signed with your own keys and broadcast to a public, permanent ledger that we do not control and cannot edit.
dataRequest.cannotDelete: We can delete our copies and stop showing your content on 3Speak. We cannot erase it from the blockchain — nobody can, including you. Anyone running a Hive node will still have it.
dataRequest.cannotExport: Your on-chain data is already public and machine-readable via any Hive API — we will point you to it. What we send you is what we hold in addition to that.
dataRequest.confirmLabel: I understand my content on the Hive blockchain is permanent and cannot be deleted by 3Speak or by anyone else.
dataRequest.foot: We reply within one month. You can also email <mail>privacy@3speak.tv</mail> directly.
dataRequest.intro: Ask for a copy of what 3Speak stores about you, or for it to be removed. Posts on Hive are public and can't be deleted.

lightning.title: Lightning tips
lightning.v4vDesc: The default, nothing to set up: tips arrive on Hive as HIVE. Tips smaller than v4v.app's conversion fee (about 60 sats) stay as sats in your v4v.app account. Enter a Lightning address below to get them in your own wallet instead.
lightning.ownDesc: Tips go straight to your own Lightning wallet, without v4v.app and its conversion fee. Saved in your Hive profile.
lightning.savedOwn: Lightning tips now go to your own address
lightning.savedV4v: Lightning tips go through v4v.app again
lightning.badAddress: That's not a Lightning address. It looks like name@wallet.com.
lightning.unreachable: This address did not answer as a Lightning address. Check it and try again.
lightning.saveFailed: Could not save it to your Hive profile.
lightning.supportersNote: Tips to your own address don't show under Supporters.
lightning.publicNote: Saved on your Hive account, where anyone can see it.

referrals.title: Invite people to 3Speak
referrals.intro: We are working to bring new creators, viewers and listeners to 3Speak. Share your link with people who would enjoy making, watching or listening to videos and podcasts here, and get rewarded for it.
referrals.shareTip: Put it in your bio, your email signature, or print it on a T-shirt. We won't judge.
referrals.bonusLabel: of their ad rewards, as creator, viewer or listener
referrals.bonusDesc: as a creator, viewer or listener
referrals.timeLabel: from the day they sign up
referrals.adsLabel: of their ad campaigns if they book ads
referrals.earnOnTop: 3Speak pays this on top. The people you invite keep everything they earn.
referrals.rules: Only new accounts that sign up through your link count. Rewards arrive with the regular ad payouts, marked as a referral bonus.
